A product of [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]], the '''DD6''' [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] was designed and produced as a direct competitor to the [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The DD6 was stronger and more powerful than its counterpart, and its production set off the so-called "blaster wars" between Merr-Sonn and BlasTech. Considered by most to have been a "standard" blaster pistol with no distinguishing features, it was a popular weapon for personal protection as well as for use as a military sidearm.
